text: {"lessons":["I added to several positions after prices had fallen; a lower price alone is not evidence of value, so I should require a clear reason before averaging down.","I should set position sizes and risk limits across the whole portfolio, rather than treating each stock as a separate account or letting any one loss dominate my decisions.","Because losses feel especially painful, I should use a written, forward-looking decision rule and follow it consistently instead of holding to avoid admitting a mistake or selling just to secure a gain."]}
